statement: Run a pre-wired wind analysis from geometry and weather input to wind speed fields around buildings without hand-building a CFD case.
superiority: One-click templated case with built-in checks that runs at a native speed and with no external solver install.

acceptance.corpus: Single-block and 3-block urban arrangements from the AIJ wind tunnel guideline cases
acceptance.tolerance: Mean velocity ratio within 15% of AIJ benchmark points

statement: Generate a cylindrical or box simulation domain sized from the building bounds with clearances and inlet direction.
superiority: Domain sized from rules (COST 732 / AIJ) with automatic blockage-ratio check.

acceptance.tolerance: Blockage ratio < 3%; domain extents within 1% of guideline formulas

statement: Create a hex-dominant mesh with refinement near buildings and ground, run through a mesh component and return cell and quality counts.
superiority: Native mesher with deterministic output and mesh preview in the viewport.

acceptance.tolerance: Max non-orthogonality < 70 degrees; cells within 5% of requested size

statement: Refine the mesh near the ground plane so near-ground pedestrian-level wind is resolved.
superiority: Gradual layer refinement with checks on y-plus and pedestrian-height cell count.

acceptance.tolerance: At least 3 cells below 2 m at probe locations

statement: Check mesh validity and preview the refined mesh without leaving the host application.
superiority: Interactive mesh preview in the viewport instead of requiring an external viewer.

acceptance.tolerance: All seeded defects reported

statement: Select a turbulence model such as k-epsilon or k-omega SST for the wind simulation.
superiority: Model choice with guidance and automatic boundary-condition consistency.

acceptance.corpus: Flow around a cube (AIJ Case A / CEDVAL)
acceptance.tolerance: Reattachment length within 20% of wind tunnel

statement: Control the total iterations, write interval and convergence controls for a wind simulation.
superiority: Convergence-driven stop rather than guessed iteration counts.

acceptance.corpus: Urban test block run to residual 1e-4
acceptance.tolerance: Stops automatically when residuals < 1e-4; results match fixed-iteration run within 1%

statement: Place probes in the simulated field and read wind speed and pressure at points of interest.
superiority: Probes remain valid after remeshing and show the sampled value in the viewport.

acceptance.tolerance: Probe values equal interpolated field within 1e-6

statement: Display probed wind vectors and speed colour maps in the host viewport after a probing run.
superiority: GPU streamlines and vector glyphs updated live during the solve.

acceptance.tolerance: Displayed values equal data within 1e-6

statement: Compute pedestrian wind comfort from simulated wind speeds and local wind statistics, with weighting by wind direction.
superiority: Standards-based comfort classes (Lawson, NEN 8100) with clear exceedance maps and auditable rules.

acceptance.corpus: Weibull wind statistics for 3 sites and an AIJ block
acceptance.tolerance: Comfort class at each probe equal reference calculation

statement: Fit directional wind statistics (Weibull) to weather data and combine with CFD results to estimate exceedance probability.
superiority: Fits with goodness-of-fit report, using hourly data.

acceptance.tolerance: Fit parameters within 2% of maximum-likelihood reference

statement: Run an annual outdoor thermal comfort study by combining wind simulation from several directions with weather and radiation data.
superiority: Direction-wise simulations cached and reused across designs to shorten annual runs.

acceptance.corpus: Cylindrical domain with 16 directions and an EPW year
acceptance.tolerance: Annual UTCI hours within 1 K band of reference workflow

statement: Use a cylindrical mesh that can rotate with the wind direction so many directions share one mesh.
superiority: Single mesh reused for all wind directions with consistent refinement.

acceptance.tolerance: Mesh reuse: cell count identical; runtime saving >= 30%

statement: Compute UTCI and PET distributions across the outdoor area from air temperature, wind, humidity and mean radiant temperature.
superiority: UTCI polynomial evaluated per cell and cross-checked against the reference implementation.

acceptance.corpus: UTCI reference table for 50 input tuples
acceptance.tolerance: UTCI within 0.1 K of reference

statement: Estimate the mean radiant temperature at outdoor points by combining shortwave and longwave exchange with surrounding surfaces.
superiority: Stable and fast MRT with no crash path and documented validity range.

acceptance.corpus: Courtyard at noon on a summer day
acceptance.tolerance: MRT within 2 K of Radiance-based reference

statement: Report surface pressure coefficients on buildings for natural ventilation and facade design.
superiority: Surface Cp mapped to facade panels with area-weighted averages.

acceptance.tolerance: Cp within 0.1 of wind tunnel values at sample points

statement: Run a fully coupled microclimate simulation of outdoor flow, heat and moisture exchange with vegetation and ground surfaces.
superiority: Coupled solver on GPU with a validated vegetation model.

acceptance.corpus: Reference urban microclimate case (courtyard with trees)
acceptance.tolerance: Air temperature within 1.5 K of measured data

statement: Simulate airflow inside buildings through openings and cross-ventilation paths.
superiority: Indoor and outdoor domains in one coupled case rather than a hand-built opening boundary.

acceptance.tolerance: Flow rate through openings within 15% of benchmark

statement: Run the CFD solver cross-platform through a container so OpenFOAM-class workflows run on any operating system.
superiority: Native solver, no container or manual solver install required.

acceptance.corpus: Same case on Windows, Linux and macOS
acceptance.tolerance: Results bit-identical across platforms

statement: Detect when a mesh or case changed after a simulation and warn before mismatched fields are loaded.
superiority: Fingerprint check blocks mismatched results instead of failing with cell-count errors.

acceptance.tolerance: Mismatch flagged 100% of the time; no crash
